absent: Runqueue structure and scheduling policy selection beyond flag and priority helpers.
Implementation of static branch, static call, tracepoint, atomic operations and thread information primitives.
Internal setter for task command names and truncation behavior beyond length enforcement.
NUMA placement algorithm and fault driven migration decisions beyond counter layout.
Performance event lifecycle and callback execution contexts beyond storage description.
Concrete numeric values of TASK_REPORT, TASK_IDLE, TASK_UNINTERRUPTIBLE and related state bits.

findings.text: The examined tail of the task descriptor aggregates many optional subsystems selected by configuration, ending with thread state called thread and a marker for the close of the randomized region, with the whole descriptor aligned to a cache line boundary. It holds scheduling state called futex and masking called ipi_mask and sequencing called rseq and context tracking called mm_cid and flush batching called tlb_ubc and pipe caching called splice_pipe and fragment caching called task_frag and dirty counts called nr_dirtied with pause threshold called nr_dirtied_pause and timing called dirty_paused_when and slack values called timer_slack_ns with defaults called default_timer_slack_ns.

Memory affinity keeps a policy pointer called mempolicy with hints called il_prev and il_weight and pref_node_fork, plus balancing controls called numa_scan_seq and numa_scan_period and numa_scan_period_max and numa_preferred_nid with retry timing called numa_migrate_retry and stamps called node_stamp and last_task_numa_placement and last_sum_exec_runtime. A callback called numa_work and a group pointer called numa_group accompany storage called numa_faults with total called total_numa_faults and summary called numa_faults_locality and tally called numa_pages_migrated.

Performance observation uses recursion record called perf_recursion with context pointer called perf_event_ctxp plus mutex called perf_event_mutex with list called perf_event_list and data called perf_ctx_data. Tracing and test coverage uses return depth called curr_ret_stack and curr_ret_depth with stack called ret_stack and stamps called ftrace_timestamp and ftrace_sleeptime and tallies called trace_overrun and tracing_graph_pause and mask called trace_recursion and latency count called latency_record_count with records called latency_record and coverage mode called kcov_mode with size called kcov_size and area called kcov_area and descriptors called kcov and kcov_remote. Additional contexts are called kasan_depth and kcsan_ctx and kmsan_ctx and kunit_test and preempt_disable_ip and task_state_change and kretprobe_instances and rethooks and user_event_mm and unwind_info.

Resource control keeps reclaim count called memcg_nr_pages_over_high with charge target called active_memcg and lookup cache called objcg and throttling disk called throttle_disk and probe linkage called utask and mapping control called kmap_ctrl and reclamation head called rcu with users called rcu_users and disable depth called pagefault_disabled and reaper linkage called oom_reaper_list with timer called oom_reaper_timer and stack area called stack_vm_area with count called stack_refcount and patch state called patch_state and security blob called security and storage called bpf_storage with context called bpf_ctx and networking called bpf_net_context and machine check fields called mce_vaddr and mce_kflags and mce_addr and mce_count with callback called mce_kill_me.

The pointer called mempolicy is guarded by the lock called alloc_lock. The pointer called numa_group allows readers under RCU protection and allows current task readers universally, while other readers require run queue locking with the target not running, and writers are limited to current in system call and fault contexts plus destruction paths. Event mutation is serialized by the mutex called perf_event_mutex. Lifetime uses counts called rcu_users and stack_refcount for persistence where thread information lives in the task.

Storage called numa_faults keeps memory and processor values fixed for a scan window while buffers accumulate current window events, then historic values decay and absorb buffered values. Summary called numa_faults_locality distinguishes remote and local and failed migration with distinct weighting for shared and private faults to adapt scan cadence. Throttling engages once count called nr_dirtied reaches threshold called nr_dirtied_pause. Slack called timer_slack_ns uses nanosecond units. The descriptor observes sixty four byte alignment and requires additions above the randomization end.

A boolean query called sched_proxy_exec reports whether proxy execution is enabled. One build resolves the answer through a likely branch object called __sched_proxy_exec while the alternate build reports disabled unconditionally. The operation has no side effects and may be used as a fast path selector.

Visible state mapping begins from reportable bits of scheduling state combined with exit state under mask called TASK_REPORT, with a dedicated value called TASK_REPORT_IDLE just beyond that mask and a doubled maximum called TASK_REPORT_MAX that must keep power of two form. Combinations with marking called TASK_IDLE select the idle value, while markings called TASK_RTLOCK_WAIT and TASK_FROZEN select value called TASK_UNINTERRUPTIBLE to conceal internal conditions. The chosen value is reduced to a bit position index and then rendered as a single character, with a build time relation tying the maximum to the character table size.

Process flag values are PF_VCPU equals 0x00000001 and PF_IDLE equals 0x00000002 and PF_EXITING equals 0x00000004 and PF_POSTCOREDUMP equals 0x00000008 and PF_IO_WORKER equals 0x00000010 and PF_WQ_WORKER equals 0x00000020 and PF_FORKNOEXEC equals 0x00000040 and PF_MCE_PROCESS equals 0x00000080 and PF_SUPERPRIV equals 0x00000100 and PF_DUMPCORE equals 0x00000200 and PF_SIGNALED equals 0x00000400 and PF_MEMALLOC equals 0x00000800 and PF_NPROC_EXCEEDED equals 0x00001000 and PF_USED_MATH equals 0x00002000 and PF_USER_WORKER equals 0x00004000 and PF_NOFREEZE equals 0x00008000.

Remaining process flag values are PF_KCOMPACTD equals 0x00010000 and PF_KSWAPD equals 0x00020000 and PF_MEMALLOC_NOFS equals 0x00040000 and PF_MEMALLOC_NOIO equals 0x00080000 and PF_LOCAL_THROTTLE equals 0x00100000 and PF_KTHREAD equals 0x00200000 and PF_RANDOMIZE equals 0x00400000 and PF__HOLE__00800000 equals 0x00800000 and PF__HOLE__01000000 equals 0x01000000 and PF__HOLE__02000000 equals 0x02000000 and PF_NO_SETAFFINITY equals 0x04000000 and PF_MCE_EARLY equals 0x08000000 and PF_MEMALLOC_PIN equals 0x10000000 and PF_BLOCK_TS equals 0x20000000 and PF__HOLE__40000000 equals 0x40000000 and PF_SUSPEND_TASK equals 0x80000000.

Atomic flag indices are PFA_NO_NEW_PRIVS equals 0 and PFA_SPREAD_PAGE equals 1 and PFA_SPEC_SSB_DISABLE equals 3 and PFA_SPEC_SSB_FORCE_DISABLE equals 4 and PFA_SPEC_IB_DISABLE equals 5 and PFA_SPEC_IB_FORCE_DISABLE equals 6 and PFA_SPEC_SSB_NOEXEC equals 7. Index 2 is absent from the enumeration.

Rescheduling debug shift MIGHT_RESCHED_RCU_SHIFT equals 8, with companion mask MIGHT_RESCHED_PREEMPT_MASK equal to one shifted by that amount minus one. Lock aware rescheduling offset PREEMPT_LOCK_RESCHED_OFFSETS equals the base lock offset in one build and equals base lock offset plus one shifted by the debug shift in the other build. Priority conversion PRIO_TO_NICE subtracts the default priority from the supplied priority to yield niceness.

Used math handling clears or sets the flag called PF_USED_MATH within state called flags on a stopped child or on current, assigns it conditionally from a boolean, copies the current value to a child, and tests it on an arbitrary task or current. Per processor thread status requires both the flag called PF_NO_SETAFFINITY and exactly one allowed processor in count called nr_cpus_allowed. User task status requires present memory called mm with neither marking called PF_KTHREAD nor marking called PF_USER_WORKER.

Atomic helpers generate test set and clear operations against storage called atomic_flags from flag names, instantiated for no new privileges with test and set, spread page with full trio, speculative store bypass disable and no exec with full trio, force disable with test and set, and indirect branch controls with corresponding trios. A restore helper on current preserves bits outside a mask within state called flags while reloading masked bits from saved values.

Niceness derives from priority called static_prio through the conversion called PRIO_TO_NICE. Idle detection tests the flag called PF_IDLE within state called flags. The union called thread_union overlays the descriptor called task with optional information called thread_info and an array called stack sized from size called THREAD_SIZE. Lookup uses an embedded member in one build and reinterprets the stack base in the other build.

Assignment to name called comm enforces exact source length against fixed length called TASK_COMM_LEN and forwards to internal setting without truncation marking. Retrieval enforces minimum destination capacity and copies with padding while returning the destination. The helper called scheduler_ipi folds a pending rescheduling request into preemption accounting, with remote marking responsible for sending the interrupt on first request.

Task flag manipulation forwards set clear update test and atomic test and set or clear requests to the thread information layer. Need rescheduling control emits a trace event on first marking of the flag called TIF_NEED_RESCHED, clears both eager and lazy indications called TIF_NEED_RESCHED and TIF_NEED_RESCHED_LAZY atomically, tests the eager request with a cold path hint, and provides a current task setter that asserts disabled interrupts before marking both thread flag and preemption state.

Conditional rescheduling offers a checked wrapper that validates calling context before invoking an internal selector with four builds covering static call dispatch, dynamic dispatch, direct invocation and a disabled stub reporting no schedule. Lock aware variants for spin locks and read write locks validate with lock specific offsets then delegate to helpers capable of dropping and retaking the lock around a schedule.

Build time shape checks require power of two form for the state maximum and a doubling relation for the state character table, plus exact or minimum sizing for command buffers. The global lazy translation query is unsafe in interrupt context and reports inactive there. Clearing need rescheduling removes both eager and lazy indications, so lazy waits must be reasserted when still required. The current task rescheduling setter must run with interrupts disabled.

Reachable scheduling entry points in these fragments are the interrupt folding helper for remote rescheduling, the current task rescheduling setter for local requests, and the conditional rescheduling wrappers for plain contexts and for contexts holding spin or read write locks. They form the voluntary preemption surface exposed here.

Activity for state called lazy_mmu_state holds exactly when count called enable_count is positive while count called pause_count is zero. The global query reports inactive inside interrupt handling and otherwise mirrors the current task evaluation.
